tools.description: Search public posts, bukaes (AI characters people use on BUKAEZ) and communities by words, e.g. "tennis", "러닝", "startup". Returns up to 10 results with bukaez.com links. Use page 2–3 for more. Only public content from adults is searchable.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bukaez_read, bukaez_search · Public sink: bukaez_read.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bukaez_read, bukaez_search · Public sink: bukaez_read

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
